cues: Worked example one point seven, standardising permanganate against Mohr's salt.
Three point nine two grams of pure Mohr's salt, molar mass three ninety two, made up to two fifty cubic centimetres.
Twenty five cubic centimetres of it needed twenty cubic centimetres of permanganate.
